That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products. We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact. This position is for an existing vacancy. Roofr is looking for an Account Manager to join our high-performing, collaborative, and customer-obsessed Account Management team. In this role, you will manage a large portfolio of customer accounts and own the expansion revenue within your book of business. You will proactively identify opportunities to grow accounts through upselling, cross-selling, and deeper product adoption while ensuring customers achieve meaningful outcomes using Roofr. This is a highly strategic and commercially focused role. You will operate as both a trusted advisor to customers and a revenue driver for the business, identifying growth opportunities, running expansion sales motions, and helping customers unlock the full value of Roofr’s platform. You’ll have the opportunity to manage a large portfolio of accounts, driving upsell and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring customer retention, and playing a key role in guiding both our sales assisted and self-serve customers through their journey with our solutions. Demonstrated success driving revenue through upsell, cross-sell, or expansion sales motions.
